tagline: Helping healthcare providers and pharmaceutical manufacturers improve patient access and enhance patient care

company_description: Cencora, Inc. sources and distributes pharmaceutical products in the United States and internationally. risks.title: Loss of major customer
risks.summary: The loss of a key customer could lead to a significant decline in revenues and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Walgreens and Boots represent 25% of revenues and 38% of accounts receivable. Evernorth represents 13% of revenues. The loss of any of these customers would have a material impact on the company's operating and financial results. The report explicitly highlights this exposure.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.summary: Geopolitical risks could have a moderate impact on international operations and logistics services.
risks.score_rationale: International operations represent approximately 9.4% of revenues. Geopolitical risks could affect operations in Europe and global logistics services, but exposure is moderate.

risks.title: Operational failures and supply chain disruptions
risks.summary: Operational failures could result in revenue losses and reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Disruptions in the supply chain or distribution issues could affect the company's ability to serve key customers and maintain sales levels.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks
risks.summary: Foreign exchange risks could affect international operations with limited impact.
risks.score_rationale: International operations represent approximately 9.4% of revenues. Currency fluctuations could affect results from European subsidiaries, but exposure is limited.

risks.title: Regulatory and reimbursement risks
risks.summary: Regulatory changes and reimbursement reductions could reduce future growth and margins.
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes, adjustments in reimbursement rates, and government policies could affect demand and profit margins. The report explicitly mentions downward pressure on reimbursement rates.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risks could affect patient data and distribution operations.
risks.score_rationale: Cencora handles sensitive patient data and proprietary information. A breach could impact operations and reputation, but the sector manages this exposure through established controls.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.summary: Strategic acquisitions and divestitures may fail to achieve expected objectives.
risks.score_rationale: The recent acquisition of RCA in January 2025 and the exploration of strategic alternatives for MWI Animal Health and Profarma carry integration risks and risks related to synergy realization.

ai_positioning.summary: Cencora does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its fiscal 2025 10-K/20-F report.
